mai.title: मन-दर्शन (Philosophy of Mind) केर नूतन प्रश्न
mai.summary: (Philosophy of Mind) केर नूतन प्रश्नक सबसे महत्वपूर्ण परिवर्तन ई अछि जे “मन कतय अछि?” सँ अधिक “कोन (phenomenon) कोन स्तर पर कोन प्रमाणसँ (explain) होइत अछि?” प्रश्न केन्द्रीय भऽ रहल अछि। (brain evidence) अपरिहार्य, मुदा एकसर पर्याप्त नहि। (neural correlation), (causal intervention), (behaviour), (phenomenology), (body), (environment) आ (social context)क (explanatory) भूमिका अलग राखल जाए।

en.title: New Questions in Philosophy of Mind
en.summary: The most important change in the new questions of Philosophy of Mind is that the central issue is becoming less “Where is the mind?” and more “Which phenomenon is explained at which level, by what evidence?” Brain evidence is indispensable, but not sufficient on its own. The explanatory roles of neural correlation, causal intervention, behaviour, phenomenology, body, environment and social context should be kept distinct. First-person experience is not the enemy of scientific inquiry; its reliability conditions should be tested.

mai.title: मन–देह समस्या
mai.summary: मन–देह समस्या एकटा (single metaphysical riddle) नहि; (ontology), (causation), (dependence), (explanation), (experience) आ (agency)क जुड़ल प्रश्न-समूह अछि। एहि विभाजन बिना (debate slogan)मे बदलि जाइत अछि। (Cartesian substance dualism subjectivity) आ (thought)क भिन्नता तीक्ष्ण बनबैत अछि, मुदा (interaction)क (account)क भार उठबैत अछि।

en.title: The Mind–Body Problem
en.summary: The mind–body problem is not a single metaphysical riddle; it is a connected cluster of questions concerning ontology, causation, dependence, explanation, experience and agency. Without these distinctions, the debate collapses into slogans. Cartesian substance dualism sharply marks the distinctness of subjectivity and thought, but carries the burden of explaining interaction.

mai.title: व्यवहारवाद, तादात्म्य सिद्धान्त (identity theory) आ कार्यात्मकतावाद (functionalism)
mai.summary: व्यवहारवाद, (identity theory) आ (functionalism) आधुनिक (philosophy of mind)क तीन निर्णायक मोड़ छथि। तीनू (Cartesian private substance)क विरुद्ध प्रतिक्रिया साझा करैत, मुदा (mental state)क (criterion), (realization) आ (causal role)क अलग प्रश्नक उत्तर दैत अछि। (Behaviorism mental vocabulary)क (public), (dispositional) आ (action-linked) पक्ष स्पष्ट कएलक।

en.title: Behaviourism, Identity Theory and Functionalism
en.summary: Behaviourism, identity theory, and functionalism are three decisive turns in modern philosophy of mind. All three react against the Cartesian private substance, but they answer different questions about the criteria, realisation, and causal role of mental states. Behaviourism clarified the public, dispositional, and action-linked aspects of mental vocabulary.

mai.title: चेतनाक कठिन समस्या
mai.summary: चेतनाक कठिन समस्या आधुनिक (philosophy of mind)क केन्द्रीय सीमा-परीक्षा अछि। ई पूछैत अछि—(functional/physical processing)क संग (subjective experience) किएक अछि, आ वैज्ञानिक (description) सँ (phenomenality)क (intelligible bridge) कोना बनत। (Chalmers)क (easy/hard distinction scientific difficulty)क (ranking) नहि, (explanatory target)क भेद।

en.title: The Hard Problem of Consciousness
en.summary: The hard problem of consciousness is a central boundary-test in modern philosophy of mind. It asks why subjective experience accompanies functional or physical processing, and how an intelligible bridge can be built from scientific description to phenomenality. Chalmers’s easy/hard distinction is not a ranking of scientific difficulty but a distinction between explanatory targets.

mai.title: उद्देश्यता (intentionality) आ आत्मबोध (self)
mai.summary: (Intentionality philosophy of mind) आ (philosophy of language)क संगम-बिन्दु अछि। ई पूछैत अछि—(mental state) किछु विषयमे कोना होइत अछि, (content) सत्य/गलत कोना होइत अछि, (absent/nonexistent object)क (direction) कोना सम्भव, आ (physical system representational normativity) कोना प्राप्त करैत अछि। (Brentano intentionality)क आधुनिक पुनरुत्थानक प्रमुख स्रोत; (Husserl lived directedness) आ (mode of presentation) गहिर करैत; (analytic traditions semantics), (causation), (information), (teleology) आ (functional role)सँ (naturalization) खोजैत।

en.title: Intentionality and Self
en.summary: Intentionality is a meeting point between philosophy of mind and philosophy of language. It asks how a mental state can be about something, how content can be true or false, how directedness towards an absent or nonexistent object is possible, and how a physical system can acquire representational normativity. Brentano is a major source of the modern revival of intentionality; Husserl deepens lived directedness and mode of presentation; analytic traditions seek naturalisation through semantics, causation, information, teleology and functional role.

mai.title: भारतीय आत्मा–अनात्मा–चित्त विवाद
mai.summary: भारतीय आत्मा–अनात्मा–चित्त विवाद एक (binary) सूची नहि, वरन् (self), (consciousness), (person), (agency), (memory), (reflexivity), (embodiment) आ (liberation)क बहुस्तरीय (philosophical field) अछि। (Nyāya enduring self-substance) केँ (cognition/agency)क (locus) मानैत, मुदा (consciousness) केँ (essential nature) नहि; (Advaita self) केँ (pure self-luminous consciousness) मानैत; (Sā)ṃ(khya-Yoga puru)ṣ(a) केँ (citta/prak)ṛ(ti) सँ पृथक; (Mīmā)ṃ(sā enduring knower-agent)क अलग (models) विकसित करैत। (Buddhist traditions permanent independent self)क आलोचना करैत, (causal continuity) आ (conventional personhood)क (models) बनबैत; (svasa)ṃ(vedana) सम्बन्धी (Yogācāra/epistemological positions) आ (Madhyamaka critiques internal plurality) देखबैत।

en.title: Indian Debates on Ātman, Anātman and Citta
en.summary: The Indian debate over ātman, anātman and citta is not a binary list but a multi-level philosophical field concerning self, consciousness, personhood, agency, memory, reflexivity, embodiment and liberation. Nyāya treats an enduring self-substance as the locus of cognition and agency without making consciousness its essential nature; Advaita understands the self as pure self-luminous consciousness; Sāṃkhya–Yoga distinguishes puruṣa from citta and prakṛti; Mīmāṃsā develops distinct models of an enduring knower-agent. Buddhist traditions criticise a permanent independent self while constructing models of causal continuity and conventional personhood; Yogācāra and epistemological positions concerning svasaṃvedana, together with Madhyamaka critiques, display significant internal plurality.

mai.title: न्याय, बौद्ध आ आधुनिक मन-दर्शन (philosophy of mind) केर त्रिकोणीय संवाद
mai.summary: न्याय, बौद्ध आ आधुनिक मन-दर्शनक त्रिकोणीय संवादक मुख्य उपलब्धि कोनो विजेता चुनब नहि, वरन् प्रश्नकेँ अधिक सूक्ष्म बनब अछि। न्याय विषयी, सम्बन्ध, ज्ञान, त्रुटि आ प्रमाणक सूक्ष्मता दैत अछि। बौद्ध दर्शन प्रक्रिया, अनित्यता, अनात्मा, निर्भर सातत्य आ स्वसंवेदनक चुनौती दैत अछि।

en.title: A Triangular Dialogue among Nyāya, Buddhism and Modern Philosophy of Mind
en.summary: The chief achievement of a triangular dialogue among Nyāya, Buddhism and modern philosophy of mind is not selecting a winner but making the questions more precise. Nyāya contributes precision concerning subject, relation, cognition, error and evidence. Buddhist philosophy contributes the challenge of process, impermanence, anātman, dependent continuity and reflexive awareness.
